accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Truth Social usernames or profile URLs, e.g. realDonaldTrump, https://truthsocial.com/@JDVance.

onlyNew.title: Only posts since the last run
onlyNew.description: For schedules (e.g. every 5 minutes): return only posts newer than the newest one the previous run saw. State lives in your named key-value store truth-social-monitor-state.

keywords.title: Keywords to flag
keywords.description: Words or names to look for, e.g. Tesla, tariff, Bitcoin, Intel. Matches go in matchedKeywords.

onlyMatching.title: Only posts that match a keyword
onlyMatching.description: Skip posts with no keyword match. Skipped posts are not charged.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: The account's replies to other posts.

includeReposts.title: Include reposts (ReTruths)
includeReposts.description: Posts the account reposted from others.
